enter: power-on; HOME tap from any page; a RESET finishes
screen: header (play, clock dot + BPM with its tempo source INT / EXT n / EXT -- / WAIT (TIMING_SPEC 5), preset, CH, algorithm, MIDI, page map, length) + channel band + 16-cell lane of the viewed page + 8-cell knob band (live row filled) + button picture (line 1 tap label; line 2 the hold sub-label h:RST h:HARM h:HLP/MENU h:UNDO L, or the dice sub-label) + black-key legend + cue strip; the lane header names hold=EDIT
knob_band: ROW 1 / ROW 2 morphs of the selected channel algorithm; with a RIG on the channel (a device with a wire that is not DEV) the band has THREE rows: the rail (tag column) shows 1 2 3 with the live row expanded to 26 px and ROW 3 = LEVEL of the device's four wires (HW_SUPPORT_LOWLEVEL 4.1)
keys: white = steps of the viewed page (tap on/off, hold = NOTE EDIT); black = moves

enter: hold a white step key 0.4 s (PERF, CHAN, SET, NOTE_EDIT)
leave: HOME tap; SELECT turn; REC tap (to REC at this step); GLO / CHAN key switch page
screen: header + lane (edited step outlined) + NOTE EDIT band: 4 knob cells PITCH GATE VELO RATCH with AUTO/set state + 6 button cells (ALL NOTE ON/OFF ACCENT SLIDE PROB) + OCT cells OCT-/OCT+ + legend + cue
knob_band: K1 PITCH, K2 GATE, K3 VELO, K4 RATCH of the edited step
keys: white: tap on/off, hold = edit that step; black = moves as PERF

enter: tap black D#4 (CHAN) from PERF, NOTE_EDIT, SET (on SCALE D#4 is inert)
leave: D#4 tap again; HOME tap; GLO / REC switch page
screen: header + lane + CHAN band: LENGTH MIDI SOURCE FOLLOW + page map (4 cells: used / viewed / playing)
knob_band: K1 LENGTH, K2 MIDI, K3 SOURCE, K4 FOLLOW
keys: white = steps (as PERF); black as PERF except D#4 = BACK

leave: GLO tap; HOME tap; CHAN key / REC switch page
screen: header + lane + SET band: BPM SWING GATE DIV (global) + 2 status lines: TEMPO INT / EXT n / EXT -- and OUT MASTER / FOLLOW, line 2 host clock takes over / K1 off: the host sets tempo / WAITING FOR HOST START (SEQUENCER_UX 2.8, SCREEN_SPEC 6.5); tag column OCT-/OCT+ = OCTAVE -/+ (shows OCT n)
knob_band: K1 BPM, K2 SWING, K3 GATE, K4 DIV
keys: as PERF (steps and moves stay live)

enter: hold GLO 0.4 s (any page but REC, MENU)
screen: header + the HARMONY screen (table id SCALE): Z2 = the progression strip (one cell per bar of the phrase, a degree numeral at each chord start, a dash for a held bar, the typing cursor, the chord name under each numeral) over a legend of keys F3-E4 = 1-7; Z3 = SCALE KEY VOICE MOVE cells with the tag column OCT-/OCT+ = DRONE -/+; status line 1 = DRONE (degree, octave, clash marks per chord), line 2 = ROLE of the selected channel; Z4 buttons PROG, BARS, ROLE, NEW replace SCL, LFO, ARP, SEQ
knob_band: K1 SCALE, K2 KEY, K3 VOICE, K4 MOVE
keys: white F3-E4 = chord degree 1-7 (type the progression; each key sounds its chord); every other key inert

enter: tap REC (from NOTE_EDIT the cursor starts at the edited step)
screen: banner REC + lane with the write cursor + REC band: CURSOR ACC SLIDE OCT + KEYS = NOTES legend
knob_band: K1 CURSOR, K2 ACC, K3 SLIDE, K4 OCT
keys: all 27 keys play and write notes (force = level SOFT / MED / HARD on F3-C5)
cue_strip: REC: PLAY KEYS TO WRITE  REC=done

enter: hold EDIT 0.4 s (PERF, NOTE_EDIT, CHAN, SET, SCALE)
leave: after ONE reset (back to the page it came from); EDIT tap or HOME tap cancels
screen: the page beneath with every resettable cell tagged RST + banner RESET
knob_band: K1-K4: that value of the page beneath back to its default (NOTE_EDIT: to AUTO)
keys: white = clear that step; black inert except D#4 = re-copy the previous page
cue_strip: RESET: TOUCH WHAT TO RESET  EDIT=no

enter: hold HOME (any page) and touch or turn any control while it is held (owner decisions 57 / 61; no time window)
leave: release HOME: back to the page it was held on (no MENU, because a control was touched)
screen: the page beneath dimmed + a 2-line help box naming the touched control and what it does on that page
knob_band: every control explains itself and does nothing (PLAY still starts / stops)
latched: no (exists only while HOME is held)

enter: hold HOME 0.7 s touching nothing, then release (any page)
knob_band: K1-K4: value of the selected row

leave: last step done or HOME tap (skip); never again
screen: PERF + the cue strip shows the guided step
cue_strip: the first-run step text (section 11); step 1 = D#4 K2: MIDI CHANNEL

enter: PG+ (D#5) while viewing the last page and length < 64
leave: PG+ again = add the page; any other control cancels the prompt and acts normally
screen: a ghost page cell + text in the cue strip naming what PG+ will do: ADD PAGE n = COPY OF n-1, SHOW PAGE n (HIDDEN), or SHOW ALL OF PAGE n (a partial last page is completed first)
cue_strip: ADD PAGE 2 = COPY OF 1? PG+ = yes

enter: hold SOLO / FILL / ROLL (black F#4 / G#4 / A#4)
screen: the held cell inverted; FILL / ROLL cell shows the live amount from key force
keys: as the page beneath (every other key, PG- / PG+ included, keeps its role while a move is held; the overlay only changes the cue strip and the held cell)

enter: turn the ALGO encoder (P2-013, owner decision 82)
leave: 2 s after the last detent (a later detent restarts the 2 s); HOME tap or any other control ends it at once
screen: the page beneath, the selected channel cell and header H4 show the new short name, and the cue strip lists all six algorithms with the current one in brackets: ACID EUCL SNAK STAG [ARP] PATT (185 px of 240)

enter: hold black key D#4 (CHN) 0.4 s (PERF, NOTE_EDIT, CHAN, SET); latched, it stays open when the key is released (owner decision 97)
leave: HOME tap; D#4 tap (BACK); GLO / REC switch page
screen: header + channel band + RIG panel in the lane area: a banner (RIG CHn and the device name) and the four wires, one line each: key digit, parameter name, LEVEL, who drives it (DEV / HAND / SEQ), the dice layer it rides, the lane form, MOVE; the selected wire inverted; NONE: a device card and the device list instead of wires + RIG band: PARAM LAYER FORM MOVE of the selected wire with a status line (CC, LEVEL, RIDE morph and a MIDI OFF warning) + the dice and page buttons as PERF
knob_band: K1 PARAM, K2 LAYER, K3 FORM, K4 MOVE of the selected wire; OCT- / OCT+ = RIDE -/+
keys: white 1-4 = wires 1-4 (tap = who drives it, hold = select only); white 5-16 inert; black as PERF except D#4 = BACK and PG- / PG+ inert
cue_strip: RIG: TAP 1-4 = WHO DRIVES  HOLD = PICK
